events.t: Live WTA Finals - Gauff v Pegula
events.sy: For a fourth consecutive year, familiar American rivals Coco Gauff and Jess Pegula clash at the year-end WTA Finals. The pair have met 10 times, with the record split at five apiece.
World number ones Katerina Siniakova and Taylor Townsend take on Italians Jasmine Paolini and Sara Errani. Cristina Bucsa and Nicole Melichar-Martinez face Demi Schuurs and Ellen Perez.
Britain's Cam Norrie arrives in Stockholm for the season's final ATP 250, getting underway against James Duckworth. Plus, last year's runner-up Ugo Humbert meets Adolfo Daniel Vallejo.
With Britain's Toby Samuel set to play home favourite Leo Borg - son of the great Bjorn Borg, the number five seed in Stockholm Tomas Martin Etcheverry takes on Sweden's own Max Dahlin.
Aryna Sabalenka returns to Indian Wells in pursuit of a first WTA Finals title, opening her campaign against Karolina Muchova - who makes her first appearance at the year-end event.
After seven years away, former champion Elina Svitolina returns - getting underway against WTA Finals debutant Mirra Andreeva, arriving here on the back a career-best season.
